messages.subject: Delta Electronics Thailand | Clean technology, smart industry and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Surapunthu and Delta Electronics Thailand Leadership Team,

Delta's position in power electronics, energy infrastructure and smart green manufacturing creates a strong fit with my experience at the intersection of industry, energy transition and institutional engagement.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. I lead government and regulatory engagement, ESG coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy across a large mining operation.

My recent work gives me direct exposure to issues central to Delta's growth agenda. I have supported stakeholder and governance work around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, along with carbon-data readiness based on physical operating evidence. I also coordinate regulators, technical teams, communities and senior leadership around complex environmental and operational priorities.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, Southeast Asia or ANZ-facing mandates across Sustainability, External Affairs, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or regional stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Delta Electronics Thailand-focused executive CV and would appreciate your sharing it with Ms. Atitaya Surapunthu, Mr. Jason Yuan or the appropriate executive team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
